note: RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 python tools/research/phase7_extension/integrated_benchmark.py         --binary target/release/axisforge --models research/phase7_extension/native/learned_order_phase7.json         --dev-costs research/phase7/results/full_online_costs.json --dev-store store.json --dev-projects POOL         --egad-timing research/phase7/results/confirmation_timing.json --egad-store CONF/store.json         --egad-projects EGAD_POOL --out research/phase7_extension/results/integrated_runtime_benchmark.json  What is measured (all exploratory, post hoc: the objects were already used in development or in the Phase VII confirmation):  - objects: the 60 development parts of full_online_costs.json and the 60 timed EGAD objects of   confirmation_timing.json, i.e. the same objects as the historical cost measurements; - modes: M0 (the original planner), and the native learned orders m1, m4, m9, joint and hybrid   (plan --learned --order MODE), every one with --nr-grasps 1, one thread, pinned to one CPU; - cold: a fresh process per call (process start, project load, model load, planning); --cold-reps   repetitions, modes in a seeded random order per object and repetition; wall time and user+system CPU   (wait4) of the process. The peak-RSS field recorded by wait4 is NOT valid: on Linux a child spawned from   Python inherits the parent's peak across exec, so every mode showed the Python parent's ~170 MiB. Memory is   measured separately by memory_benchmark.py from the planner's own VmHWM; - warm: one process per object and mode planning --warm-calls times (project and models loaded once,   the situation of a persistent service); the first call and the median of the remaining calls; - per call: the planner's own stage timings (setup, generation, ranking, the learned stage by step,   search with the IK/collision/static rejections), the number of examined candidates and the first grasp; - consistency: the first grasp and number examined of every call must be identical across repetitions.  Statistics per mode against M0, paired by object: geometric mean of the per-object time ratio with a bootstrap 95 % CI (10 000 resamples of objects, seed 20261211), the number of objects faster/slower, the median, p90, p95, p99 of absolute times, and the exploratory Wilcoxon signed-rank p of the log ratios. Load averages before and after each object are recorded; the machine was not otherwise idle unless the output's 'other_processes' list is empty.

environment.note_on_reaggregation: aggregates recomputed from the per-object raw files after the run, to drop the invalid wait4 RSS field; measurements unchanged

memory: see memory_benchmark.json (the rss_mib values in raw are the Python parent peak, invalid)
